scope: Bounded local three-camera review loop, source inspection plus an independent unit-test run.

unit_tests.renderer: Explicit fake_blender.py test double; these tests are not Cycles visual validation.

verified_controls: Three required camera images, exact hashes, spec hash, artifact hashes, and review identity binding.
Review templates remain pending and cannot be submitted as acceptance.
A reviewer must attest actual inspection of hero, side, and top; unresolved P0/P1 issues cannot be accepted.
Only allowlisted bounded numeric scene parameters may be revised; arbitrary code, budget, camera, and unknown edits are rejected.
Maximum three iterations, per-render deadline, total active execution limit, and zero paid-service ceiling.
Timed-out renderer process group is killed, including tested descendant cleanup.
Run lock and fresh iteration folders prevent overlapping writes and silent overwrite.
Image measurements explicitly have no aesthetic or realism verdict.

open_findings.finding: Record generator source identity per iteration, not only spec/output hashes, to make code changes between iterations auditable.
open_findings.acceptance_check: Iteration metadata includes build_scene.py SHA-256 or a source commit, or explicitly labels code-changing comparisons as look-development revisions.
open_findings.resolution: Current runner writes builder.snapshot.py and records/checks its SHA-256 before each camera render. The completed real run began before this addition; its before/after is explicitly labeled look-development with source changes, not parameter-only control.

open_findings.finding: The separate motion helper used subprocess.run timeout without process-group cleanup at audit time.
open_findings.acceptance_check: Motion timeout terminates Blender and all descendants, verified by code/test evidence.
open_findings.resolution: render_motion.py now calls the tested cgstudio.budget.run_renderer process-group wrapper. Per-frame callback also kills its owned POSIX process group. Original full motion render already completed; no forced-timeout real Blender motion run was performed.

no_claims: No independent full-browser rendering or A/B/C optical equivalence.
No API-model automation or fabricated visual metrics.
